## What this changes

Say what a reader of the API or of the docs can do after this change that they could not do before.

## Why

Name the problem or the request. Link the issue if there is one.

## How you checked it

`pixi run -e dev check` runs every check that CI runs. Say what else you tried, such as the demo (`pixi run demo`) or a request you sent by hand.

## Before you ask for a review

- [ ] `pixi run -e dev check` passes.
- [ ] A new behavior has a test that fails without the change.
- [ ] The docs and the OpenAPI text say what the code now does.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased, if a user can notice the change.
- [ ] No password, key, cookie, real name, or real portal address is in the code, the tests, the docs, or this description. Test data uses the made-up `5afe0000-...` ids and reserved example domains.
- [ ] A change that sends something to the school sits behind a switch that is off by default.
